rows.definition: NewSchedulingGateway(gw, sched) (internal/microagent/slotsched.go) wraps the ONE shared model Gateway with cooperative slot scheduling, so every model call routes through the Scheduler with a priority hook before it reaches the underlying gateway.
rows.distinction: Not the served API gateway (internal/gateway wire server) and not FAK_MAC_GATEWAY (a remote compute target) - this is an in-process DECORATOR constructor that fronts the shared Gateway with slot admission, opt-in behind the microagent Scheduler.
